transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve been doing some odd things at work and school. Like things that don’t really make sense. Lining receipts across the floor, tapping the calculator in sets of nine… sometimes I just stand by the copier with my hands up until someone asks if I’m okay. It’s embarrassing.
Have you ever had experiences where you saw, heard, or felt things that others around you didn’t seem to notice?

Yeah… sometimes. Not seeing things, really. More like I’ll hear a man’s voice when I’m by myself, at my desk or walking home from class. It’ll say stuff like, “check line seven,” or “you missed the sign.” It’s clear enough that I look around, but… nobody’s there.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are not your own or like someone is putting thoughts into your head?
I don’t think so. I mean… I’ve had weird thoughts, but they still feel like mine, I guess. I haven’t noticed someone putting them there.
Have you ever had beliefs or ideas that other people don’t seem to understand, or that turn out not to be true, even though they feel very real to you?

Yeah… kind of. I know it sounds strange, but sometimes I get really sure that invoice totals or account numbers, due dates… things like that are messages about me. Like they’re tracking whether I understand some pattern.

My supervisor has shown me they’re just normal entries, and I get that, sort of. But it still feels real at the time.
Do these messages ever lead you to believe something about yourself or the world that others don’t seem to understand, even after you’ve talked about it with them?

Yeah… I guess it makes me think there’s some kind of pattern I’m supposed to catch. Like the totals or due dates aren’t just random entries, they’re… about me somehow.

I know people don’t really get that, and my supervisor has shown me they’re normal, but in the moment it still feels like they’re tracking whether I understand it.
Do you ever feel like the messages or patterns you're noticing are specifically directed at you by someone or something, like they're trying to communicate with you personally?

Yeah… sometimes it feels like that. Not like I know who’s doing it, but the invoice totals or account numbers, due dates… they feel like they’re about me. Like they’re checking if I’m seeing the pattern.

I know my supervisor says they’re just normal entries, and I can kind of see that, but in the moment it still feels directed at me.
How long have these experiences with the messages and the voice been going on? Have they been happening every day, off and on, or only occasionally?
Um… it’s been going on for a while. Maybe around eight months now, with the voice and the numbers feeling like messages. Not every minute or anything, but… yeah, it’s been there off and on.
Have these experiences with the voice and the messages been present for at least one continuous month, or have they only been happening off and on without lasting that long continuously?

Yeah… I mean, it wasn’t just a few days here and there. It’s been going on for months—around eight months, I guess. The voice and the numbers feeling like messages… they’ve been there off and on during that time.
Have the times when you felt like the numbers or messages were directed at you happened almost every day for at least a month, or have they mostly come and gone without lasting that long?

Yeah… I think it was almost every day for a while. Like with invoice totals or account numbers, I’d start feeling like they were messages about me.

Even when my supervisor said they were just normal entries, I still had that feeling… like they were tracking whether I understood the pattern.
Have these experiences affected your ability to function at work or school, or caused problems in your relationships or other important areas of your life?

Yeah… it’s affected things. Work mostly.

I used to be able to finish ledgers pretty easily, but they started coming back with serious errors. I’ve had to ask for help with stuff that used to be routine. And… I failed an important course module too. So, yeah, it’s caused problems.
Have you experienced any other unusual thoughts, beliefs, or sensory experiences—like seeing things, hearing other voices, or feeling sensations—that others don’t seem to notice?

Sometimes… when I’m by myself, like at my desk or walking home from class, I hear a man’s voice.

It’ll say stuff like, “check line seven,” or “you missed the sign.” It’s clear enough that I look around, but… there’s nobody there.
Have you ever had any beliefs or ideas that other people would consider strange or impossible, even after you’ve talked about them with others?

Yeah… I guess so.

It’s mostly the numbers at work. Like invoice totals, account numbers, due dates… sometimes I get really sure they’re messages about me. My supervisor has shown me they’re just normal entries, but I still feel like they’re tracking whether I understand the pattern.
Have you noticed any changes in how you experience emotions or motivation lately—like feeling less pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or having trouble starting or finishing tasks?

Yeah… some.

I still care about people, I think. I just… don’t answer texts much. I’ll see them and leave them there. And I skip hanging out after class a lot.

Even stuff I used to like—music shows, art projects—when friends talk about it, I kind of feel… flat. It’s harder to get myself to start things.
During the past eight months, was there ever a time when you experienced these messages or the voice for at least one full month straight without a break?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been going on, off and on, for about eight months. The voice and the numbers feeling like messages… I don’t think there’s been a whole month where it completely stopped.
